name: One-Pan Lemon Garlic Chicken Thighs
description: Crispy chicken thighs with a bright lemon-garlic pan sauce. This has been my family's go-to for years!

recipeInstructions.text: Preheat the oven to 425°F. Pat the chicken dry and season with salt and pepper. I always do this the night before, my kids love how crispy it gets!
Heat the olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat. Sear chicken skin-side down for 6 minutes until golden, then flip.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute. Pour in the lemon juice and chicken broth and sprinkle with thyme.
Transfer the skillet to the oven and roast for 20 minutes until the chicken reaches 165°F.
Garnish with parsley and serve with the pan sauce. Enjoy!

name: 15-Minute Garlic Butter Shrimp
description: Fast, buttery shrimp for busy nights.
recipeIngredient: 1 pound large shrimp, peeled and deveined
recipeInstructions: Melt the butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Add garlic and red pepper flakes and cook 1 minute. Add shrimp in a single layer and cook 2 minutes per side until pink. Stir in lemon juice and season with salt and pepper. Sprinkle with parsley and serve.

name: Classic Fluffy Buttermilk Pancakes
description: Tall, tender pancakes for a lazy weekend breakfast.

recipeInstructions.text: Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda and salt in a large bowl.
In another bowl, whisk the buttermilk, eggs, melted butter and vanilla. You'll want to make sure the butter isn't too hot or it'll scramble the eggs (trust me, I learned the hard way).
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry and stir just until combined; a few lumps are fine. Let the batter rest 5 minutes.
Heat a griddle over medium heat and lightly grease it. Pour 1/3 cup batter per pancake and cook 2 to 3 minutes until bubbles form, then flip and cook 1 to 2 minutes more.
Serve warm with maple syrup.

name: Weeknight Black Bean Tacos
recipeIngredient: 2 (15 oz) cans black beans, drained and rinsed
recipeInstructions: Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat. Sauté onion for 5 minutes until soft.
Add garlic, cumin, chili powder and paprika and cook 1 minute. Stir in the beans with 1/4 cup water and simmer 5 minutes, mashing about half.
Warm the tortillas in a dry skillet for 30 seconds per side.
Fill tortillas with beans and top with avocado, salsa, cilantro and a squeeze of lime.

name: Creamy Tuscan White Bean Soup
description: A cozy pot of beans, greens and parmesan.

recipeInstructions.text: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add onion, carrots and celery and cook 8 minutes until softened.
Stir in garlic and Italian seasoning and cook 1 minute.
Add beans, broth and tomatoes. Bring to a boil, then simmer 15 minutes.
Mash some beans against the pot to thicken. Stir in kale and cook 5 minutes until wilted.
Stir in cream and parmesan, season with salt and pepper, and serve.

name: Sheet Pan Salmon with Roasted Vegetables
description: Healthy dinner with almost no cleanup.
recipeInstructions: Preheat oven to 400°F. Toss potatoes with 1 tablespoon oil, salt and pepper on a sheet pan and roast 12 minutes. Push potatoes aside, add salmon and asparagus, drizzle with remaining oil and sprinkle with garlic powder and paprika. Top salmon with lemon slices. Roast 12 to 14 minutes until salmon flakes easily. Garnish with dill and serve.

name: Slow Cooker Beef Chili
description: Set it in the morning, dinner is waiting.
recipeIngredient: 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese, for serving

recipeInstructions.text: Brown the ground beef with the onion in a large skillet over medium-high heat for 8 minutes, breaking it up as it cooks. Drain the fat.
Transfer to the slow cooker and add pepper, garlic, beans, tomatoes, tomato sauce, chili powder, cumin and salt. Stir to combine.
Cover and cook on low for 6 hours.
Serve topped with cheddar and sour cream.

name: Thai Peanut Noodle Bowls
recipeInstructions: Cook the rice noodles according to package directions, about 8 minutes. Drain and rinse with cold water.
Whisk peanut butter, soy sauce, vinegar, honey, sesame oil, ginger, garlic and 3 tablespoons warm water until smooth.
Toss the noodles with the sauce, cabbage, bell pepper and carrots.
Divide into bowls and top with green onions and peanuts.

name: Homemade Pasta Bolognese
description: A slow, rich Sunday sauce worth the wait.
recipeIngredient: 1 (28 oz) can San Marzano tomatoes, crushed

itemListElement.text: Melt butter with oil in a heavy pot over medium heat. Cook pancetta 5 minutes, then add onion, carrot and celery and cook 10 minutes until very soft.
Add the beef and pork and cook 10 minutes, breaking it up, until no longer pink.
Pour in the milk and simmer until it has almost completely evaporated, about 15 minutes. This is the secret my nonna swore by.
Add the wine and reduce by half, about 10 minutes. Deglaze any browned bits from the bottom of the pot.
Stir in tomatoes, tomato paste and bay leaf. Simmer uncovered on the lowest heat for 2 hours, stirring occasionally.
Boil the tagliatelle in well-salted water for 3 minutes. Reserve 1 cup pasta water and drain.
Toss the pasta with the sauce, adding pasta water as needed. Serve with parmesan.

name: Greek Chickpea Salad
keywords: no cook, healthy, vegetarian, gluten free
recipeIngredient: 2 (15 oz) cans chickpeas, drained and rinsed
recipeInstructions: Chop the cucumber, halve the tomatoes and slice the onion. Whisk olive oil, vinegar, oregano, salt and pepper in a large bowl. Add chickpeas, vegetables and olives and toss. Top with feta and serve.

name: Vegan Coconut Chickpea Curry
description: Creamy, warming curry in one pot.
recipeInstructions: Heat coconut oil in a large pot over medium heat. Sauté onion 5 minutes.
Add garlic, ginger, curry powder and garam masala and cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in chickpeas, coconut milk, tomatoes and salt. Simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in spinach until wilted, then add lime juice.
Serve over rice.

recipeInstructions.text: Preheat oven to 350°F and line an 8x8 pan with parchment.
Whisk melted butter and sugar, then beat in eggs and vanilla until glossy.
Stir in cocoa, flour, salt and baking powder just until combined. Fold in chocolate chips.
Spread in the pan and bake 25 to 28 minutes. Cool 30 minutes before cutting. Seriously, wait, they firm up as they cool!

name: Spinach and Feta Egg Muffins
description: Make-ahead breakfast you can grab and go.
keywords: meal prep, gluten free, low carb
recipeInstructions: Preheat oven to 350°F and grease a 12-cup muffin tin. Whisk eggs, milk, salt and pepper. Divide spinach, pepper and feta among the cups and pour egg mixture over. Bake 20 minutes until set. Cool 5 minutes before removing.

name: Grilled Cheese and Tomato Soup
recipeInstructions: Heat the soup in a saucepan over medium heat for 10 minutes. Butter the bread, add cheese and cook in a skillet 3 minutes per side until golden. Serve together.

name: Beef and Broccoli Stir-Fry
description: Better than takeout and faster too.
recipeInstructions: Toss steak with cornstarch. Whisk soy sauce, brown sugar, oyster sauce, sesame oil and 1/4 cup water.
Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a wok over high heat. Stir-fry broccoli 3 minutes and remove.
Add remaining oil and sear the beef 2 minutes per side.
Add garlic and ginger for 30 seconds, return broccoli, pour in sauce and cook 2 minutes until glossy.
Serve over rice.

name: Overnight Oats with Berries
recipeInstructions: Stir oats, almond milk, yogurt, chia seeds and maple syrup in a jar. Cover and refrigerate for 8 hours or overnight. Top with berries and serve.

name: Chicken Tikka Masala
recipeIngredient: 1 1/2 pounds boneless chicken thighs, cut into bite-size pieces
recipeInstructions: Toss the chicken with yogurt, half the garam masala, the cumin and salt. Let it sit 15 minutes.
Melt butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken 6 minutes until browned, then remove.
Add onion and cook 5 minutes. Add garlic, ginger, chili powder and the rest of the garam masala and cook 1 minute.
Stir in tomato sauce and simmer 10 minutes. Stir in cream and return the chicken. Simmer 8 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Garnish with cilantro and serve over rice.

name: Shrimp Fried Rice
description: Better than takeout and a great use for leftover rice.
recipeInstructions: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a wok over high heat. Cook the shrimp 2 minutes per side and remove.
Add another tablespoon oil and scramble the eggs 1 minute, then remove.
Add remaining oil, peas and carrots and garlic and stir-fry 2 minutes.
Add the rice and press it into the wok. Cook 3 minutes without stirring so it crisps, then toss.
Stir in soy sauce, sesame oil, shrimp, eggs and green onions. Toss 1 minute and serve.

name: Baked Ziti
recipeInstructions: Preheat oven to 375°F. Boil the ziti 7 minutes, just under al dente, and drain.
Brown the sausage in a large skillet over medium-high heat for 8 minutes. Stir in the marinara.
Mix ricotta, egg, parmesan, Italian seasoning, salt and pepper in a bowl.
Toss the pasta with the sauce. Layer half in a 9x13 baking dish, dollop the ricotta mixture over it, and top with the remaining pasta.
Sprinkle with mozzarella, cover with foil and bake 20 minutes. Uncover and bake 15 minutes more until bubbly.
Let it rest 10 minutes before serving.

name: Turkey Taco Lettuce Wraps
description: All the taco flavor, none of the tortilla.
keywords: low carb, gluten free, quick, healthy
recipeInstructions: Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook onion 3 minutes.
Add turkey and cook 7 minutes, breaking it up, until no longer pink.
Stir in chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, salt and 1/4 cup water. Simmer 2 minutes.
Spoon into lettuce leaves and top with tomatoes, avocado, cheddar and a squeeze of lime.

name: Lemon Herb Roast Chicken
description: The weekend roast that makes the whole house smell amazing.
recipeInstructions: Preheat oven to 425°F. Pat the chicken very dry.
Rub butter all over the chicken and season inside and out with salt and pepper. Stuff the cavity with lemon, garlic, thyme and rosemary. Truss the legs with kitchen twine.
Scatter carrots and onion in a roasting pan and set the chicken on top.
Roast 1 hour 20 minutes, until the thickest part of the thigh reaches 165°F.
Rest the chicken 15 minutes before carving. Serve with the vegetables and pan juices.

name: Pork Carnitas
recipeIngredient: 3 pounds boneless pork shoulder, cut into large chunks
recipeInstructions: Rub the pork with salt, cumin and oregano.
Place the pork, onion and garlic in the slow cooker. Pour the orange and lime juice over it.
Cover and cook on low for 8 hours until the pork falls apart.
Shred the pork with two forks. Spread on a sheet pan and broil 5 minutes until the edges are crispy.
Serve in warm tortillas with cilantro and diced onion.

name: Pesto Pasta with Cherry Tomatoes
recipeInstructions: Boil the penne for 11 minutes. Reserve 1/2 cup pasta water and drain.
Heat oil in the pot over medium heat and cook the tomatoes 3 minutes until they start to burst.
Add the pasta, spinach, pesto and a splash of pasta water and toss 1 minute until the spinach wilts.
Season with salt and pepper and top with parmesan.

name: Black Bean Sweet Potato Chili
keywords: vegan, gluten free, one pot, healthy
recipeIngredient: 2 medium sweet potatoes, peeled and diced
recipeInstructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat. Cook onion and bell pepper 6 minutes.
Add garlic, chili powder, cumin and paprika and cook 1 minute.
Add sweet potatoes, beans, tomatoes, broth and salt. Bring to a boil, then simmer 25 minutes until the sweet potatoes are tender.
Stir in lime juice and serve.

name: Honey Garlic Salmon
recipeInstructions: Whisk honey, tamari, lemon juice and garlic in a small bowl.
Season salmon with salt and pepper. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and sear the salmon skin-side up for 4 minutes.
Flip, pour in the sauce and cook 4 minutes, spooning the sauce over the fish until it thickens.
Sprinkle with green onion and serve.

name: Sausage and Peppers Sheet Pan
description: One pan, three ingredients that matter.
recipeInstructions: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Toss peppers and onion with oil, Italian seasoning, salt and red pepper flakes on a sheet pan. Nestle the sausages in.
Roast 30 minutes, flipping the sausages halfway, until browned and cooked through.

name: Mushroom Risotto
recipeInstructions: Warm the broth in a saucepan over low heat.
Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat. Cook mushrooms 6 minutes until browned, then remove.
Lower heat to medium. Cook shallot 2 minutes, add garlic and rice and toast 2 minutes.
Add wine and stir until absorbed. Add broth one ladle at a time, stirring often and waiting until each is absorbed, about 20 minutes total.
Stir in mushrooms, butter and parmesan. Season with salt and pepper, top with parsley and serve right away.

name: Classic Smash Burgers
recipeInstructions: Divide beef into 4 loose balls. Butter and toast the buns in a hot skillet 1 minute, then set aside.
Heat a cast iron skillet over high heat. Add a ball of beef and smash it flat with a spatula. Season with salt and pepper.
Cook 2 minutes until the edges are crispy, flip, add cheese and cook 1 minute.
Build the burgers with lettuce, tomato and sauce.

name: Avocado Toast with Jammy Eggs
recipeInstructions: Boil the eggs for 7 minutes, then move them to ice water for 2 minutes and peel.
Toast the bread.
Mash avocado with lemon juice, salt and pepper and spread on the toast.
Halve the eggs, lay them on top and sprinkle with red pepper flakes.

name: Banana Oat Blender Muffins
keywords: gluten free, make ahead, kid friendly
recipeInstructions: Preheat oven to 375°F and grease a 12-cup muffin tin.
Blend everything except the chocolate chips until smooth, about 1 minute. Stir in the chocolate chips.
Fill the muffin cups and bake 18 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool 10 minutes before removing.

name: Breakfast Burritos
description: Make a batch on Sunday, breakfast all week.
recipeInstructions: Brown the sausage in a large skillet for 8 minutes, then remove.
Cook the hash browns in the same skillet 8 minutes until crispy.
Whisk eggs and milk, pour into the skillet and scramble 3 minutes until just set.
Divide eggs, sausage, hash browns, cheese and salsa among the tortillas and roll them up tightly.
Eat now, or wrap in foil and freeze up to 3 months.

name: Chicken Caesar Wraps
description: Caesar salad you can eat with one hand.
recipeInstructions: Season chicken with salt and pepper. Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and cook 5 minutes per side until 165°F inside.
Rest 5 minutes, then slice.
Toss romaine with dressing, parmesan and croutons.
Fill the tortillas with salad and chicken and roll up.

name: Caprese Sandwich
description: Summer between two slices of bread.
recipeInstructions: Spread pesto on the cut sides of the bread.
Layer mozzarella, tomato and basil. Season with salt and pepper and drizzle with balsamic glaze.
Close, cut in half and serve.

name: Chicken Noodle Soup
description: Cozy, classic, cures what ails you.
recipeInstructions: Melt butter in a large pot over medium heat. Cook onion, carrots and celery 7 minutes.
Add garlic and cook 1 minute. Add broth, chicken, thyme and bay leaf and bring to a boil.
Simmer 15 minutes until the chicken is cooked. Remove the chicken and shred it.
Add noodles and simmer 8 minutes. Return the chicken, stir in parsley and season with salt and pepper.

name: Roasted Tomato Basil Soup
recipeInstructions: Preheat oven to 425°F. Toss tomatoes, onion and garlic with oil and salt on a sheet pan.
Roast 35 minutes until soft and charred at the edges.
Transfer to a pot with the broth and basil and blend until smooth.
Stir in cream and simmer 5 minutes.

name: Garlic Parmesan Roasted Broccoli
keywords: side dish, gluten free, vegetarian, quick
recipeInstructions: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Toss broccoli with oil, garlic and salt on a sheet pan.
Roast 20 minutes until the edges are crispy.
Sprinkle with parmesan and lemon juice and serve.

name: Crispy Smashed Potatoes
recipeInstructions: Boil potatoes in salted water for 20 minutes until fork-tender. Drain.
Preheat oven to 450°F. Spread potatoes on an oiled sheet pan and smash each one flat with a glass.
Drizzle with oil and season with salt, pepper and garlic powder.
Roast 25 minutes until deeply golden and crispy. Sprinkle with parsley.

name: Classic Chocolate Chip Cookies
recipeInstructions: Preheat oven to 375°F and line baking sheets with parchment.
Beat butter and both sugars 2 minutes until fluffy. Beat in eggs and vanilla.
Mix in flour, baking soda and salt until just combined. Stir in chocolate chips.
Scoop 2-tablespoon balls onto the sheets, 2 inches apart.
Bake 10 to 11 minutes until the edges are golden. Cool on the sheet 5 minutes.

name: No-Bake Peanut Butter Energy Bites
keywords: no cook, snack, gluten free, vegetarian
recipeInstructions: Stir everything together in a bowl until combined.
Chill 30 minutes so it's easier to roll.
Roll into 1-inch balls and store in the fridge.

name: Spinach Artichoke Dip
recipeIngredient: 1 (14 oz) can artichoke hearts, drained and chopped
10 ounces frozen spinach, thawed and squeezed dry
recipeInstructions: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Mix cream cheese, sour cream and mayonnaise until smooth. Stir in artichokes, spinach, garlic, half the mozzarella and the parmesan.
Spread in a small baking dish and top with the remaining mozzarella.
Bake 25 minutes until bubbly and golden. Serve with chips or bread.

name: Mediterranean Quinoa Bowls
keywords: meal prep, vegan, gluten free, healthy
recipeInstructions: Rinse quinoa, then simmer in the water covered for 15 minutes. Fluff and cool.
Whisk oil, lemon juice, oregano, salt and pepper.
Divide quinoa among bowls and top with chickpeas, cucumber, tomatoes, olives and onion.
Drizzle with dressing and add a scoop of hummus.
